hints.title: Prefix Sum Spread Extremes Obstacle
hints.text: The absolute sum of a subarray equals the difference between two prefix sums. What combination of prefix values maximizes this absolute difference?

hints.title: Prefix Extrema Range Invariant
hints.text: The maximum absolute subarray sum corresponds to the spread between the maximum and minimum cumulative prefix sums reached across the sequence.

hints.title: Cumulative Max Min Tracking Procedure
hints.text: Track running cumulative sum starting from 0. Record the overall maximum and minimum cumulative sums encountered. The answer is the maximum cumulative sum minus the minimum cumulative sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input element count or target integer bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing all O(N^2) subarray sums directly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking prefix extremes takes O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that subarray sum equals prefix[j] - prefix[i], so absolute sum is bounded by max(prefix) - min(prefix).
